question: How were the figs in the two baskets different?
options: One had big figs and one had small figs
One had green figs and one had purple figs
One had very good figs and one had very bad figs
One had dried figs and one had fresh figs
explanation: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other had very bad figs, so bad they could not be eaten.
